figures.name: overview
figures.caption: Box state through the run: height above the local surface, speed (impact speed and rest threshold as references), spin, contact force (weight as reference) and the energy budget. Shaded spans: box in contact.

figures.name: kinematics
figures.caption: Velocity and angular-velocity components of the box: linear velocity in the bed frame, spin in the bed frame and in the box's own axes.

figures.name: path
figures.caption: Where the box went. Left: the local terrain (hillshaded height) with the box path coloured by time, the aim point, the free crop (solid) and frozen ring (dashed). Right: the same seen from the side along the approach direction, with the terrain profile and the box outline at first contact and at the end.

figures.name: contacts
figures.caption: Contacts on the box. Left: where on the box surface it was touched (unfolded box, +z face in the middle), each dot one contact at one sample, coloured by time and sized by normal force. Right: normal force on the box over time, per contact.

figures.name: force_chains
figures.caption: Contact force network (top view) before the impact and at the contact frame with the largest total normal force: each segment joins a body centre to a contact point, coloured and widened by normal force. The box is outlined.

figures.name: energy_budget
figures.caption: Where the arrival energy went: box translation and rotation, grain motion, and the share lost in contacts, at arrival, at the moment of exit and at the end of the run.

figures.name: bed_response
figures.caption: What the bed did. Left: each free grain at its starting place, coloured by how far it moved by the end (box footprint at first contact, crop circle). Middle: displacement against distance from the touchdown point. Right: grains in motion and the fastest grain over time.

figures.name: scene3d
figures.caption: The crop in 3-D at the end of the run: free grains (coloured by how far they moved when grain frames exist, otherwise by kind), the frozen ring faded, the box at its start (outline) and final pose, and its path coloured by speed.

figures.name: solver
figures.caption: Numerical health: solver iterations per step (budget line = did not converge), deepest interpenetration in the crop over time against the smallest grain, and the mean number of contacts per body.
